meta_title: Monkey Vine Rush · Hold. Swing. Fly! · iPhone & iPad
meta_desc: Hold to swing, let go to fly! Swing through 24 wild worlds and 1,200 levels, beat the bosses and outrun the chaser. No ads, plays offline, fun for all ages. On iPhone and iPad.
og_title: Monkey Vine Rush · Hold. Swing. Fly!
og_desc: Swing through 24 wild worlds and 1,200 levels. No ads, plays offline, fun for all ages. On iPhone and iPad.
hero_lede: Explore 24 wild worlds, leap from vine to vine, beat the bosses and race ahead of the chaser. Easy to pick up and packed with adventure.
feat_h2:
Easy to learn.
Impossible to put down.
feat_p: Every swing feels amazing, and there's always one more level, one more banana and one more world to unlock.
f1_p: Press anywhere to grab a vine, build up your swing, then let go at just the right moment to soar. Tap in mid-air for a Power Spin.
f1_li1: Build momentum and fly sky high
f1_li3: Earn three stars on every level
f2_p: Frosty peaks, bubbling volcanoes, candy kingdoms, coral reefs, haunted hollows, neon cities and more, each with its own weather, hazards and a boss to beat.
f3_h3: Run! The chaser is right behind you
f3_p: In endless Rush, a jaguar, a yeti, a lava wave and more are hot on your tail. Swing as far as you can, grab power-ups on the way and beat your best.
f3_li2: Weather that changes as you go
f4_p: Unlock new monkeys, each with their own perks, then mix and match outfits, hats, swings and sparkly trails. Super Cape, Royal Crown, Rainbow Grapple… you choose.
f5_p: Open a daily gift, take on the daily challenge, complete missions and collect badges. There's always a reason to come back for one more swing.
fam_h2: Fun you can feel good about
fam1_p: No pop-ups or videos in the way. Just play.
fam2_p: Perfect for car rides, flights and anywhere without Wi-Fi.
fam3_p: No sign-ups, and no personal data collected.
fam4_p: Pick up where you left off on your iPhone or iPad.
final_p: Join the rush on iPhone and iPad. Your first vine is waiting.

s_desc: Help and contact for the Monkey Vine Rush game: purchases, moving to a new device, reporting a problem.
s_sub: Answers to common questions, and how to reach us.
s_need: Need help? Email us and we'll get back to you, usually within a few days.
selected: Selected. Copy it with your device.
q1: I paid for coins but they didn't arrive
a1:
Close the game completely (swipe it away in the app switcher) and open it again. Any purchase that finished while the game was closed or interrupted is added when the game starts.

If a grown-up has to approve purchases (Ask to Buy), the coins arrive as soon as they approve it.

Still missing? Email us with the date of the purchase and which coin pack it was.
q2: Can I restore my coins on a new device?
a2: Coin packs are used up when you buy them, so they can't be restored like an app or a subscription. Your coin balance is part of your progress, though, and moves with it (see "Moving to a new device" below).
q3: How do I turn off in-app purchases?
a3:
On iPhone or iPad, open Settings › Screen Time › Content & Privacy Restrictions › iTunes & App Store Purchases › In-app Purchases and choose Don't Allow.

The game also asks a grown-up question before every purchase. Buying coins is never needed: everything can be unlocked by playing.
q4: How do I ask for a refund?
a4: Apple handles payments and refunds. Go to reportaproblem.apple.com, sign in with the Apple Account that made the purchase, and choose the coin pack.
a5:
Your progress is saved on your device and, in the App Store version, in your own iCloud. To bring it to a new iPhone or iPad:

  1. Sign in to the new device with the same Apple Account.
  2. Make sure iCloud is turned on for the game: Settings › your name › iCloud.
  3. Install Monkey Vine Rush and open it. Your progress loads by itself.
q6: I reinstalled the game and my progress is gone
a6: If iCloud was on, open the game again while connected to the internet and give it a moment to load your progress. If it still starts from the beginning, email us.
q7: The game runs slowly or stutters
a7: Turn on Low graphics in the game's Settings. It draws fewer effects and runs smoothly on older devices. Closing other apps can help too.
q8: How do I learn the moves?
a8: Hold the screen to swing, let go to fly, and touch the next vine to grab it. Tap in the air for a Power Spin. The tutorial and the Power-up guide in the game show every move with an animation.
q9: I found a bug, or the game froze
a9: Open the game's Settings › Report a problem, tap Copy report, and paste it into an email to us. The report lists your device and any errors the game noticed, and nothing personal, so we can find the problem quickly.
privacy_p: The game has no adverts, no tracking and no chat, and collects no personal information. Read the full privacy policy.
p_desc: Privacy policy for the Monkey Vine Rush game: no adverts, no tracking, no personal information collected.
trans_note: This is a translation of our privacy policy. If it differs from the English version, the English version applies.
sum_1: No adverts, no tracking, no chat.
sum_2: We don't collect names, email addresses, locations or any other personal information.
sum_3: Coin purchases are optional, go through Apple or Google, and need a grown-up to answer a question first.
who: Monkey Vine Rush is a game. This policy explains what information the game uses and why.
stores:
• Your progress: coins, stars, levels, items, missions, badges and settings. This is saved on your device so you can carry on where you left off.
  • An online copy of your progress, if you play while signed in to the service that hosts the game, so your progress can be restored on another device. It is linked to your account there and holds only game progress. In the app store versions, this copy is kept in your own iCloud or Google Play Games account instead.
  • Ghost replays of your best runs. These stay on your device only.
notcollect_h: What the game does not collect
notcollect: The game does not ask for or collect your name, email address, contacts, location, photos, microphone or camera, and it does not use advertising IDs. There are no adverts, no third-party analytics or tracking, no chat and no social features. We do not sell or share your information.
purchases:
Buying coins is never required. Everything in the game can be unlocked with coins earned by playing. Buying coins is optional and simply gives you a faster way to unlock worlds, monkeys and items.

Coin packs are in-app purchases made through the App Store or Google Play. Payments are handled by Apple or Google under their own terms and privacy policies. The game only receives confirmation that a purchase went through, never your card or payment details.

Coins can only be used in the game. They have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their refund policies.

You can turn off or limit in-app purchases in your device's settings, for example with a password or parental controls.
boards:
In the app store versions, if you are signed in to Game Center or Google Play Games, your best Rush distances and your star total can be posted to their leaderboards. Those services show your player name there under their own privacy policies.

The Share button makes a picture of your result and opens your device's share options. Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it.

Before coins can be bought, or anything is shared outside the game, a grown-up has to answer a quick question.
fonts: The game's fonts are built into the game, so it does not contact any font service or other third party when it loads.
children: The game is suitable for all ages. Because it collects no personal information, it can be played without sharing anything about yourself.
choices: You can delete all progress saved on your device at any time with Reset progress in Settings. To have an online copy of your progress removed, email us at the address below.
translations: The game's text in languages other than English was translated with the help of AI. Translations may contain mistakes or read differently from the English, and if there is any difference, the English version applies. We are not responsible for errors in translated text.
marks: All names, characters, monkeys, outfits, hats, items, worlds and other content in the game, including everything in the shop, are original creations made for Monkey Vine Rush. Any resemblance to real people, brands, products, trademarks or copyrighted characters is coincidental and not intended. The game is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any trademark or copyright owner. Apple and Google are named only to explain how app store payments work, and their names belong to their owners.
